_doc: Ratchet baselines for ci/static-checks.mjs (DESIGN_SPEC §8.2 Q items 3-5), measured at c95cc03. Owner: Q.
phase: 3 since 2026-09-29 (Phase 3 integration, Q fix round 1); the orchestrator sets it to 1, 2, 3 after each phase merges. A scope listed in
mustBeZeroByPhase[p] for every p <= phase must have zero banned-string hits ('*' = every scope).
Preview a later phase without editing this file: node ci/static-checks.mjs --phase 1

bannedStrings: hits per scope (absent = 0; c95cc03 counts ratcheted down after each phase; 2026-09-29 at a447c24: only "(bundle)" 1 = the top-level slug ZX_BLOG_AGENTS_OPS, 0 after S3's slug fix). A PR fails if any scope rises. Owning streams lower their
own scopes with: node ci/banned-strings.mjs --write-baseline (never raises). Inspect: node ci/banned-strings.mjs --hits <scope>
styleAttributes: max count of style=" in the bundle (2,196 at c95cc03; 1,229 after Phase 3; 1,017 after the Phase 3 integration merge of rd/h, a447c24, 2026-09-29); lower it after each phase.
undefinedVars: var(--z*) names used without a fallback and defined nowhere at c95cc03; S1's token block defines them,
then remove them here. Any other undefined name fails.
smokeOverflow390: ci/smoke.mjs rect-overflow ratchet, outermost offending elements per page at 390px on production
with c95cc03's files. Fails when a page gets worse; from phase 3 every count must be 0 (launch precondition 6).
Exempt hits (not counted; ci/banned-strings.mjs header): facts data, DEAD_FUNCTIONS (verified unreachable on every run),
URL/path tokens, and DATED_EXEMPTIONS (renderPrivacyV7 'SOC 2 Type II certification', A2P-frozen, since 2026-09-29).
List them: node ci/banned-strings.mjs --exempt; reachability report: node ci/banned-strings.mjs --dead
